title: SEO
subtitle: How the site appears on Google and X

preview.label: Preview
preview.noDescription: No description – Google picks a snippet itself.

routes.empty: Without an entry every page uses its app title and the defaults from “General”.
routes.order: Order: the page's own data (e.g. custom pages) → exact path → path with /* → defaults.

form.pathHint: One path like /timeline – or /news/* for all subpages.
form.title: Title
form.titleHint: Empty = the app's title, on the home page “{{title}}”. Ideally up to 60 characters.
form.descriptionHint: Ideally up to 160 characters – Google cuts the rest.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: One or two sentences on why a click is worth it
form.indexHint: Off = noindex, and the page leaves the sitemap.
form.inSitemapHint: Helps Google find the page faster.
form.inSitemapPrefix: Paths with /* aren't listed in the sitemap themselves.
form.schemaTypeHint: Helps search engines understand what the page is.
form.jsonLdHint: Without “@type” it extends the page, with “@type” it's added as its own node.

errors.pathInvalid: Starts with / and contains only letters, digits, - . _ ~ $ – optionally /* at the end.

delete.title: Delete entry?
delete.description: {{path}} will use the app title and defaults again.

error.unknown: That didn't work. Please try again.
error.notAuthorized: You don't have permission for this.
error.path_exists: There's already an entry for this path.
error.url_invalid: Please enter an https URL or a path like /image.jpg.
error.template_invalid: The template needs %s for the page title.
error.same_as_invalid: Up to 10 https links, one per line.

settings.indexingOffText: Every page carries noindex and the sitemap is empty. Meant for test environments only.
settings.siteNameHint: Shown in search results and on X cards.
settings.titleTemplateHint: %s is replaced by the page title. Example: {{example}}
settings.defaultDescriptionHint: For every page without its own description.
settings.twitterHandleHint: Shown as the source on X cards.
settings.logoHint: Square, at least 112 × 112 pixels – for the organization on Google.
settings.sameAsHint: One link per line, {{max}} at most.
settings.indexingHint: Off = the whole site is closed to search engines.

sitemap.indexingOff: Indexing is off – that's why the sitemap is empty.
sitemap.hint: Served by the backend (runtime). The links inside point to the website (FRONTEND_URL). Renews after every change here and otherwise every 15 minutes – submit the address once in Google Search Console.
sitemap.empty: The sitemap is empty. Add paths or publish custom pages.
